name: Atago Hanae
source:
Mother of Misaki Atago, a female student whom the protagonist is in charge of. She is a good wife and wise mother who loves her husband and daughter. Her husband is a manager at a well-known company, and they live in a detached house with a garden.

However, she is a quiet and refined woman who does not put her wealth on display. Using her daughter's unofficial application as bait, she falls into a cunning trap...!

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/hogosya1/hogosya1.htmll]official site[/url]]
